name: MTAC 416 446 (MTAC, 446 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".779 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".399 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .416, Grains 446, Minimum Required Twist *1-12", Part Number MTAC 416 446, G1 BC .779 (A.B.), G7 BC .399 (A.B.), OAL 2.023", Bullet Projection 1.290"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.290".
